_why_not_1_20_0: The existing onnxruntime-1.20.0 manifest cannot run Chatterbox. Its language_model graph uses the com.microsoft GroupQueryAttention contrib op with 11 inputs (position_ids and attention_bias were added after 1.20); 1.20 accepts at most 9 and rejects the model at load with 'input size 11 not in range [min=7, max=9]'. This affects every language_model variant including q4f16, so it is a runtime-version constraint, not a quantization choice.
